ActivityEvent.description: Heatmap row-flash on every decoded frame with a node; `scene` rides only a function-button frame.
ActivityEvent.title: ActivityEvent

AddUserRequest.description:
POST /api/users — admin: create an account. ``username`` non-empty, ≤ 64 chars, no ``|`` or ``/``
(the session token is ``username|expiry``); ``password`` 8..1024; ``role`` one of the three. A
duplicate username is a 409 (never an overwrite).
AddUserRequest.title: AddUserRequest

AuditEvent.description:
One audit-log row (store_sql.recent_audit). id/ts are non-null; the five string fields are
nullable at the DB layer (model defensively as str|null), null when the action has no such field.
AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent

AuditFeed.description: GET /api/audit — newest-first rows (capped 200); `events` always present ([] when audit off).
AuditFeed.title: AuditFeed

AutomationDeleted.description: 200 from POST /api/automations/delete: `deleted` is false (200, not 404) for an absent id.
AutomationDeleted.title: AutomationDeleted

AutomationSaved.description: 200 from POST /api/automations: the saved rule's id (NOT the rule object).
AutomationSaved.title: AutomationSaved

AutomationsList.description: GET /api/automations — every saved rule. `automations` (NOT `rules`) is always present.
AutomationsList.title: AutomationsList

code.description: Eight Crockford base32 characters after uppercasing, stripping spaces and dashes, and mapping O to 0 and I or L to 1. U is rejected.
code.title: Code

candidate_token.description: HMAC bound to the owner, transaction, three dates and merchant evidence shown at preview.
candidate_token.title: Candidate Token

source_kind.description: Defaults to paste, stored as live_text. local_ocr is stored as local_ocr.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

text.description: UTF-8 text is additionally capped at 32 KiB and 500 lines.
text.title: Text

ChangePasswordRequest.description:
POST /api/me/password — the signed-in user changes their OWN password. ``current`` is verified
(a stolen cookie alone can't rotate it) before the ``new`` hash is written. ``new`` is 8..1024.
ChangePasswordRequest.title: ChangePasswordRequest

ControlError.description: The 400 (malformed) / 503 (device unavailable) body: ``ok`` false + a human error string.
ControlError.title: ControlError

ControlRequest.description: A device control command — one variant per device op.

ControlSuccess.description: The 200 body when a control command reaches the device: ``ok`` true + the ``sent`` wire frame.

sent.description: the device command frame that was sent, hex-encoded
sent.title: Sent

ControlSuccess.title: ControlSuccess

ControlSwitch.description: Turn a relay/light on or off (optionally a single gang of a multi-gang node).

endpoint.description: multi-gang channel 1 or 2; omit for single-gang
endpoint.title: Endpoint

ControlSwitch.title: ControlSwitch

ControlThermostatPower.description: Power a thermostat/TRV on or off.
ControlThermostatPower.title: ControlThermostatPower

DbStats.description:
GET /api/db/stats — SQLite on-disk size + per-table row counts (admin). ``tables`` maps each
tracked table name to its current row count.
DbStats.title: DbStats

DeviceInfo.description:
One device, merged from the classifier + the user registry (``proxy._discovery_entry``). The base
+ live-state fields are ALWAYS present (required), null when unseen — so `0`/`false` are never lost.
The registry labels (``name``/``room``/``endpoint_names``) are OPTIONAL — absent until set, never null.
``confidence`` is usually a string but a legacy/hand-edited registry node (a ``type`` without a
``confidence``) can surface null, so the contract admits it. NOTE: the whole-home scene opt-out
(``exclude_from_all``) is deliberately NOT exposed here — it lives only on the dedicated
``/api/whole-home`` surface, so adding it never changes this (client-decoded) response shape.
DeviceInfo.title: DeviceInfo

DeviceStatePatch.description:
A partial of DeviceInfo — exactly the live-state keys a frame can change (State.apply's `changed`
map, after `scene` is popped). Discovery-side fields (power/type/confidence/battery/last_seen) never
ride a `state` event — they arrive via a discovery_changed refetch.
DeviceStatePatch.title: DeviceStatePatch

Discovery.description:
``GET /api/discovery`` — the whole dashboard snapshot. Every key is always present; ``klima_state``
is null until an A/C IR command is seen, ``env_override`` is null unless ``HESTIA_MODE`` pins the mode.
Discovery.title: Discovery

Globals.description:
Node-less global fields (``proxy.globals_snapshot``). Every key is ALWAYS present (required),
null when its poller is off. ``crib_temp_ts`` / ``outdoor_temp_ts`` are the ISO ts of the last
crib / outdoor sample (the "N ago" freshness badge); ``outdoor_battery_ok`` is the local 433 sensor's
battery flag (false = low) — null when HESTIA_RTL433_BATTERY_WARN is off (the default).
Globals.title: Globals

GlobalsPatch.description:
A partial of Globals — the changed global field(s) in a `globals` event (2 keys for the niania /
Open-Meteo poll: value + its `*_ts`; up to 4 for a 433 reading: temp, humidity, ts, battery).
GlobalsPatch.title: GlobalsPatch

IrButton.description: A configured one-tap IR button (``HESTIA_IR_BUTTONS``) → transmits a saved Flipper signal.
IrButton.title: IrButton

IrRequest.description: POST /api/ir — transmit a saved Flipper IR signal (same 200/400/503 envelopes as /api/control).
IrRequest.title: IrRequest

Klima.description:
The A/C control map parsed from the klima.ir signal names — an empty ``{}`` when no klima.ir is
present, so every field is OPTIONAL (absent, never null). ``modes``/``power_on`` map each mode to its
sorted temps; ``presets`` carries ``off`` + any non-temp signal.
Klima.title: Klima

KlimaState.description: The A/C state derived from IR traffic (``state``): power + optional mode/target.
KlimaState.title: KlimaState

LoginRequest.description:
POST /api/login body. ``bearer: true`` opts a native client into a token in the response (which
it then sends as ``Authorization: Bearer``); the browser omits it and relies on the httponly cookie.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

LoginSuccess.description: 200 from /api/login. ``token`` is present ONLY when the request set ``bearer: true``.
LoginSuccess.title: LoginSuccess

NameRequest.description:
POST /api/name — set a device's registry labels. ``node`` is required; at least one of
name/room/type must be present (server-enforced cross-field, not expressible here). name/room
accept null (clear); type is a DeviceType; ep is a multi-gang channel label. Unknown keys → 400.
NameRequest.title: NameRequest

ResetPasswordRequest.description:
POST /api/users/reset-password — admin: set ANOTHER user's password (no current-password check).
Refuses self (an admin rotates their OWN credential via /api/me/password, which verifies the current
one). NOTE the field is ``new`` (not ``password``).
ResetPasswordRequest.title: ResetPasswordRequest

Rf433Device.description:
One discovered 433 MHz device (``rf433.Rf433Registry.snapshot``). ``fields`` is the last decoded
packet's JSON-safe scalars (rtl_433 ``time``/``mic`` noise stripped). All five keys are always present.
Rf433Device.title: Rf433Device

Rf433Feed.description:
GET /api/rf433 — every decoded 433 device, newest-seen first (admin observability). ``devices`` is
``[]`` until the local-433 feeder is running.
Rf433Feed.title: Rf433Feed

RoomIconRequest.description: POST /api/rooms/icons — set one shared room emoji. Send icon="" (empty string, NOT null) to clear.
RoomIconRequest.title: RoomIconRequest

Rule.description: A saved automation rule (automations.Rule.to_dict) — all 7 keys ALWAYS present in the output.
Rule.title: Rule

RuleAction.description:
One action. Only `op` (+ ir's file/button) is validated at save; all other per-op fields are
author-supplied and pass through verbatim — so this is open (extra=allow), not a closed per-op union.
RuleAction.title: RuleAction

RuleInput.description:
POST /api/automations body. id/trigger/actions required; enabled/modes/debounce/conditions are
optional (server-defaulted by Rule.from_dict: enabled=true, modes=[proxy,standalone], debounce=0,
conditions=[]). Authoritative validation is Rule.from_dict — this shape is the codegen guide.
RuleInput.title: RuleInput

RuleVocab.description: The automation-rule grammar the guided form builds from (``automations.rule_vocab``).
RuleVocab.title: RuleVocab

Scene.description: A function-button press riding an `activity` event. `kind` distinguishes the two frame types.
Scene.title: Scene

SceneRequest.description: POST /api/scene — fan one house-wide scene out across the per-device control path.
SceneRequest.title: SceneRequest

SceneResult.description: 200 from /api/scene: how many of the scene's per-device commands the gateway accepted.
SceneResult.title: SceneResult

SetDisabledRequest.description: POST /api/users/disabled — admin: enable/disable ANOTHER account. Refuses self + the last enabled admin.
SetDisabledRequest.title: SetDisabledRequest

SetRoleRequest.description:
POST /api/users/role — admin: change ANOTHER user's role. Refuses self (no self-demote) and the
last enabled admin (server-enforced). ``username`` only has to be non-empty (it names an existing
account, so the create-time char rules don't re-apply).
SetRoleRequest.title: SetRoleRequest

Settings.description:
GET /api/settings — the logged-in user's UI prefs. All three keys are ALWAYS present, null when
unset (an unauthenticated / no-row request returns all-null, never an error).
Settings.title: Settings

SettingsUpdate.description:
POST /api/settings — a PARTIAL update: only the keys present are persisted (absent keys are left
untouched). null clears a field. temp_scale ∈ {C,F,K}. locale ≤ 35 chars.
SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate

StatePredicate.description: A condition with NO `type` key (the absence IS the discriminant vs time_window).
StatePredicate.title: StatePredicate

TimeWindowCondition.description: A time-of-day guard condition. `days` is OMITTED entirely when unset (unlike time/sun triggers).
TimeWindowCondition.title: TimeWindowCondition

UserRow.description:
One account in the admin user list (``store_sql.list_users``) — username / role / disabled,
NEVER the password hash.
UserRow.title: UserRow

UsersList.description: GET /api/users — every account (admin). ``users`` is always present; there is NO top-level ``ok``.
UsersList.title: UsersList

WhoAmI.description: GET /api/whoami — the caller's identity + RBAC role; both null when auth is off (loopback/dev).
WhoAmI.title: WhoAmI

WholeHomeConfig.description:
GET /api/whole-home — what is opted out of the house-wide "all lights / all blinds" sweeps.
Registry-only config (deliberately NOT in DeviceInfo, so adding the opt-out never changes the
device-snapshot wire shape a pinned native client decodes). ``excluded_nodes`` = whole devices;
``excluded_endpoints`` = single gangs of a multi-gang switch (node id → sorted gang numbers).
WholeHomeConfig.title: WholeHomeConfig

WholeHomeRequest.description:
POST /api/whole-home — opt one device in (``exclude``=false) / out (true) of the house-wide
"all" sweeps. With ``ep`` (gang 1 or 2, like the control op's ``endpoint``) the opt-out targets
that single gang of a multi-gang switch instead of the whole node.
WholeHomeRequest.title: WholeHomeRequest

At five active tokens, a new device name is rejected with 409 device_token_limit_reached; same-name rotation remains allowed.

get.description: Pure read-only single-snapshot monthly budget dashboard evaluated in Europe/Warsaw from one UTC instant. Computes booked configured start budget, adjusted category spending and limits, rent/mortgage pass-through, unresolved transfer and repayment candidate provisional flags, previous-month expected income estimates (including cross-account salary matching), and spending pace. Card exposure is reported as unavailable in P1. Makes no bank requests and no database writes.

parameters.description: Optional calendar month YYYY-MM, 1900 through the current Europe/Warsaw month; defaults to current month.
parameters.name: period

parameters.description: Optional uppercase 3-letter ISO currency code; defaults to PLN.
parameters.name: currency

200.description: Owner-private monthly budget dashboard and ledger coverage from one local snapshot.

400.description: Invalid monthly budget query: period must match ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$ through the current Europe/Warsaw month, currency must match ^[A-Z]{3}$, and unknown or duplicate parameters are rejected.

401.description: session required; middleware may return an empty body

403.description: admin owner or browser-origin requirement failed; middleware may return an empty body

409.description: SQLite backend required: monthly-budget requires HESTIA_PERSIST=sqlite.

413.description: Monthly budget limit exceeded (>100,000 selected rows, >1,000 category limits, >192-character aggregate decimal output, or >4 MiB UTF-8 JSON payload); no partial totals returned.

500.description: Stored ledger, category, limit, metadata, or timestamp integrity check failed (`budget_analytics_data_error`), including stored-data helper errors mapped to 500 after query validation, or unexpected internal failure (`budget_internal_error`).

503.description: Analytics storage, Europe/Warsaw time zone, or monthly budget configuration unavailable (`budget_analytics_unavailable` or `budget_unavailable`).

get.summary: Read the owner-private monthly budget dashboard
